Skill Development Training

Hands-on Training

EmbryoGenesis, an infertility diagnostic and research centre in Mohali, Punjab, offers hands-on skill development training in eight laboratory programmes. Gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art laboratory techniques in reproductive sciences. Our training programs ensure real-world expertise for future professionals.

Seat in Batch: 10 1 to 5 Days 8 programmes

Eligibility

Who can apply for skill development training?

Eligibility: B.Sc. MLT, M.Sc., Ph.D., MBBS, MD, Faculty of Life Science, Allied Health Science.

Students and graduates looking for a full degree can also explore our B.Sc. & M.Sc. courses in Clinical Embryology.

Hands-on Training on

How long is each training programme, and what is the fee?

Each of the eight hands-on training programmes at EmbryoGenesis, Mohali, runs for 1 to 5 Days with 10 seats per batch. Fees range from 1000/- for Biochemistry (Semi Auto Analyser, 1 day) to 35,000/- for Stem Cell Processing & Cryopreservation (1 day).
